source_refs.note: Book p. 56-59: 2.11.1 Linearization, Recall! box, Fig. 2.6 with the x, f(x), L(x) table, Examples 22-23

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humne idea dekha tha: point ke qareeb curve aur us ki tangent line takreeban ek jaisi hoti hain. Aaj hum is idea ko ek formula ki shakal denge, aur phir \(\sqrt{9.2}\) aur \(\cos 91^\circ\) jaisi values bina calculator ke nikalenge. Sab se pehle definition dekhte hain.
Agar function \(f(x)\) point \(x = a\) par differentiable hai (yani wahan derivative mojood hai), to yeh approximating function

blocks.text_alt: L of x equals f of a plus f prime of a times (x minus a)

blocks.text: \(x = a\) par \(f(x)\) ki linearization kehlata hai. Aur yeh approximation

blocks.text_alt: f of x is approximately equal to L of x

blocks.text: yani \(f(x)\) ko \(L(x)\) se approximate karna, \(x = a\) par \(f(x)\) ki local linear approximation kehlata hai. Point \(x = a\) ko approximation ka centre kaha jata hai: yeh woh jagah hai jahan se hum shuru karte hain.

Jis function ki shakal \(y = mx + c\) ho, jahan \(m\) slope aur \(c\) \(y\)-intercept hai, use linear function kehte hain. Linear function ka graph seedhi line hota hai.
Maan lein \((a, f(a))\) graph \(y = f(x)\) par ek point hai. Agar \(f(x)\) differentiable hai to \((a, f(a))\) par tangent line ki equation yeh hai:
\(y = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\).
blocks.title: Recall!

blocks.text: Formula ke har hisse ko alag se samajh lete hain, taa ke yeh ratta na lage. \(f(a)\) woh value hai jo humein pehle se maloom hai, yani shuruaat ki unchaai. \(x - a\) yeh batata hai ke hum centre se kitna aage (ya peeche) gaye. \(f'(a)\) slope hai, yani har ek unit aage jane par function takreeban kitna badalta hai. To \(f'(a)(x - a)\) poori tabdeeli ka andaza hai, aur \(f(a)\) mein yeh tabdeeli jor dein to nayi value ka andaza mil jata hai. Bilkul aise jaise aap jaante hon ke gaari 60 km har ghante chal rahi hai aur abhi 100 km ke nishaan par hai; aadhe ghante baad woh takreeban \(100 + 60 \times 0.5 = 130\) km par hogi.
Kitab ke Recall! box mein tangent line \(y = f(a) + f'(a()x - a)\) chhapi hai, yani bracket ghalat jagah hai. Sahi equation \(y = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\) hai, jo humne upar likhi hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text:
Yeh formula kaam kyun karta hai? Recall! box se milayein: \(L(x)\) bilkul wahi tangent line hai jo \((a, f(a))\) par hai, bas \(y\) ki jagah \(L(x)\) likh diya.
Dekhiye: \(x = a\) rakhein to \(L(a) = f(a) + 0 = f(a)\), yani line curve ko usi point par chhooti hai. Aur \(L'(x) = f'(a)\), yani line ka slope wahi hai jo curve ka us point par hai. Unchaai bhi same, rukh (direction) bhi same: is liye \(a\) ke qareeb dono saath saath chalti hain.
Kab use karein? Jab \(f(x)\) nikalna mushkil ho, lekin qareeb ke kisi point \(a\) par \(f(a)\) aur \(f'(a)\) aasaan hon: perfect square, perfect cube, ya standard angle jaise \(30^\circ, 45^\circ, 90^\circ\).
blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text:
Har sawal ka tareeqa (recipe), yaad kar lijiye:
1. \(f(x)\) aur centre \(a\) chuniye: \(a\) required value ke qareeb ho aur \(f(a)\) aasaan ho.
2. \(f(a)\) nikaliye.
3. \(f'(x)\) nikaal kar \(f'(a)\) nikaliye.
4. \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\) likhiye.
5. Required \(x\) ko \(L(x)\) mein rakhiye aur jawab \(\approx\) ke saath likhiye.
blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text: Ab Fig. 2.6 dekhiye. Curve \(f(x) = x^{2}\) ke graph par point \((1, f(1))\) par tangent line \(L(x) = 2x - 1\) hai. Yeh line tangency ke point (jahan line curve ko chhooti hai) ke qareeb curve ke bohat paas rehti hai. \(x = 1\) ke dono taraf chhote se interval mein tangent line ki \(y\)-values curve \(f(x) = x^{2}\) ki \(y\)-values ka acha andaza deti hain. Neeche wali table mein \(L(x)\) aur \(f(x)\) ka farq dekh kar hum yeh baat khud dekh sakte hain. Aur yeh sirf is curve ki baat nahi: har differentiable curve apne point ke qareeb apni tangent line jaisa hi bartao karti hai.

blocks.alt: Parabola f(x) = x square aur seedhi line L(x) = 2x minus 1 ka graph. Line parabola ko point (1, 1) par chhooti hai, jise (1, f(1)) likha hai, aur x = 1 ke qareeb us ke bohat paas rehti hai; line x-axis ko x = 0.5 par kaatti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.6: f(x) = x² ki (1, f(1)) par tangent line L(x) = 2x − 1 (textbook ki figure ke mutabiq original drawing)
x = 1 ke qareeb f(x) = x², L(x) = 2x − 1 aur un ka farq

blocks.text:
\(L(x) = 2x - 1\) kahan se aaya? \(f(x) = x^{2}\), \(a = 1\): \(f(1) = 1\), \(f'(x) = 2x\), \(f'(1) = 2\). To \(L(x) = 1 + 2(x - 1) = 2x - 1\). Bilkul hamari recipe!
Ab table ki aakhri row parhiye: \(x = 1\) par farq 0 hai, \(0.9\) aur \(1.1\) par sirf 0.01, aur \(0.7\), \(1.3\) par barh kar 0.09 ho gaya. Asal mein \(f(x) - L(x) = x^{2} - 2x + 1 = (x - 1)^{2}\), yani ghalti centre se faasle ka square hai. Faasla aadha karein to ghalti chauthai reh jati hai. Isi liye centre ke qareeb andaza itna acha hota hai.
blocks.title: Teaching note

blocks.text: Ab kitab ki do examples hal karte hain. Har ek mein wohi recipe chalegi: centre, value, derivative, line, aur phir required value.

Example 22 mein function ke andar square root hai. \(\sqrt{9.2}\) ko seedha nikalna mushkil hai, lekin \(\sqrt{9} = 3\) to sab ko yaad hai. To hum aisa centre chunenge jahan andar 9 bane, aur wahan se tangent line par chal kar 9.2 tak pohanchenge. Dhyan se dekhiye ke har qadam par hum kya kar rahe hain aur kyun.

blocks.title: Example 22
blocks.problem:
(a) Find the local linear approximation of \(f(x) = \sqrt{2x - 1}\) at \(x = 5\).
(b) Use the local linear approximation obtained in part (a) to approximate \(\sqrt{9.2}\), and compare your approximation to the result produced directly by calculator.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sqrt{2x - 1}\), centre \(a = 5\).
Maloom karna: (a) \(x = 5\) par \(L(x)\); (b) \(\sqrt{9.2}\) ka andaza aur calculator se muqabla.
Tareeqa: formula \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\). Is ke liye sirf do numbers chahiye: \(f(5)\) aur \(f'(5)\). Part (b) mein woh \(x\) dhoondenge jis se \(2x - 1 = 9.2\) bane, aur use \(L(x)\) mein daal denge.

(a) Qadam 1: Derivative nikalein
\[f(x) = \sqrt{2x - 1} \quad \text{...(1)}\]
\[f'(x) = \tfrac{1}{2}(2x - 1)^{-1/2}(2)\]
\[f'(x) = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2x - 1}} \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{u}\) ko \(u^{1/2}\) likha. Power rule se \(\tfrac{1}{2}u^{-1/2}\) aaya, aur chain rule ne andar wale function \(2x - 1\) ka derivative 2 multiply karwaya. 2 aur \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) aapas mein cancel ho gaye.
Dhyan dein: andar ka derivative (2) bhoolna bohat aam ghalti hai; phir jawab do guna ghalat aata hai.

Qadam 2: Centre \(x = 5\) par values
\[f(5) = \sqrt{2(5) - 1} = \sqrt{9} = 3\]
\[f'(5) = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{9}} = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
Kyun: \(x = 5\) is liye chuna ke \(2(5) - 1 = 9\) perfect square hai, to dono values bilkul saaf nikal aati hain. Centre hamesha aisa chuniye jahan hisaab zubani ho jaye.

Qadam 3: Linearization banayein
\[L(x) = f(5) + f'(5)(x - 5)\]
\[= 3 + \tfrac{1}{3}(x - 5)\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{3}(9 + x - 5)\]
\[L(x) = \tfrac{1}{3}(x + 4)\]
Kyun: yeh point \((5, 3)\) par tangent line hi hai. \(\tfrac{1}{3}\) common nikal kar shakal saaf ho gayi: 3 ko \(\tfrac{9}{3}\) likha.
Yani \(x = 5\) ke qareeb \(\sqrt{2x - 1} \approx \tfrac{1}{3}(x + 4)\) ...(3)

(b) Qadam 4: \(\sqrt{9.2}\) kis \(x\) se banega?
\[2x - 1 = 9.2\]
\[x = 5.1\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{9.2}\) asal mein \(f(5.1)\) hai. 5.1 centre 5 ke bohat qareeb hai (sirf 0.1 door), is liye andaza acha aana chahiye.

Qadam 5: (3) mein \(x = 5.1\) rakhein
\[\sqrt{2(5.1) - 1} \approx \tfrac{1}{3}(5.1 + 4)\]
\[\sqrt{9.2} \approx \tfrac{1}{3}(9.1)\]
\[\sqrt{9.2} \approx 3.0333 \quad \text{...(4)}\]
Kyun: dekhiye, right side par ab koi square root nahi, sirf jama aur taqseem. Yahi linearization ka kamaal hai: mushkil kaam aasaan line par shift ho gaya.

Qadam 6: Calculator se muqabla
\[\sqrt{9.2} = 3.0331 \quad \text{...(5)}\]
(4) aur (5) se pata chalta hai ke calculator ki value linear approximation ke bohat qareeb hai.
Kyun: 5.1 centre se sirf 0.1 door hai, wahan curve aur tangent line takreeban saath saath chalti hain.

Tasdeeq:
\[3.0333^{2} \approx 9.2011\]
Yeh 9.2 ke bohat qareeb hai. Farq \(3.0333 - 3.0331 = 0.0002\) bohat chhota hai. Hamara andaza thora sa bara hai, kyun ke \(\sqrt{2x - 1}\) ka graph neeche ki taraf murta hai aur tangent line us ke upar rehti hai.
blocks.answer: (a) \(L(x) = \tfrac{1}{3}(x + 4)\), yani \(x = 5\) ke qareeb \(\sqrt{2x - 1} \approx \tfrac{1}{3}(x + 4)\). (b) \(\sqrt{9.2} \approx 3.0333\); calculator \(3.0331\): bohat qareeb.

blocks.text: Example 22 se seekh: sab se zaroori faisla centre chunna tha. Agar hum ghalti se \(x = 4.5\) jaisa centre lete to \(\sqrt{2(4.5) - 1} = \sqrt{8}\) aata, jo khud mushkil hai. Centre hamesha wahan rakhiye jahan values zubani nikal aayen aur jo required value ke bilkul qareeb ho.

Ab Example 23 mein trigonometry aa rahi hai. Yahan ek nayi baat seekhni hai: angle ko radians mein badalna. Calculus ke saare trigonometric derivatives radians ke liye bane hain, is liye degree wala angle seedha formula mein nahi daal sakte. \(91^\circ\) ke sab se qareeb aasaan angle \(90^\circ\) hai, jahan cosine aur sine dono zubani maloom hain.

blocks.title: Example 23
blocks.problem:
(a) Find the local linear approximation of \(f(x) = \cos x\) at \(x = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\).
(b) Use the local linear approximation obtained in part (a) to approximate \(\cos 91^\circ\), and compare your approximation to the result produced directly by a calculator.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \cos x\), centre \(a = \frac{\pi}{2}\) (yani \(90^\circ\)).
Maloom karna: (a) \(L(x)\); (b) \(\cos 91^\circ\) ka andaza aur calculator se muqabla.
Tareeqa: \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\). \(91^\circ\) sirf \(1^\circ\) zyada hai \(90^\circ\) se, aur \(\cos 90^\circ\) humein zubani yaad hai. Angle radians mein lena zaroori hai, kyun ke \(\frac{d}{dx}\cos x = -\sin x\) sirf radians mein sahi hai.

(a) Qadam 1: Derivative
\[f(x) = \cos x \quad \text{...(1)}\]
\[f'(x) = -\sin x \quad \text{...(2)}\]
Kyun: cosine ka standard derivative. Minus sign yaad rakhiye.

Qadam 2: \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par values
\[f\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = \cos\tfrac{\pi}{2} = 0\]
\[f'\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = -\sin\tfrac{\pi}{2} = -1\]
Kyun: \(\cos 90^\circ = 0\) aur \(\sin 90^\circ = 1\). Slope \(-1\) ka matlab: is jagah cosine ka graph neeche ja raha hai.

Qadam 3: Linearization
\[L(x) = f\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) + f'\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\left(x - \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\]
\[= 0 + (-1)\left(x - \tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\]
\[L(x) = -x + \tfrac{\pi}{2} \quad \text{...(3)}\]
Kyun: dono values formula mein rakhin aur bracket khola: \((-1)(x) = -x\) aur \((-1)(-\frac{\pi}{2}) = +\frac{\pi}{2}\).
Is liye \(f(x) \approx L(x)\), aur (1), (3) se:
\[\cos x \approx -x + \tfrac{\pi}{2} \quad \text{...(4)}\]

(b) Qadam 4: \(91^\circ\) ko radians mein badlein
\[91^\circ = 91 \times \dfrac{\pi}{180} = \dfrac{91\pi}{180}\]
\[\dfrac{91\pi}{180} \approx 1.588250\]
Kyun: formula (4) radians ke liye bana hai, is liye angle bhi radians mein chahiye.
Dhyan dein: kitab yahan \(1.588825\) chhaapti hai, jo misprint hai; sahi value \(1.588250\) hai (neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhiye).

Qadam 5: (4) mein rakhein
\[\cos 91^\circ \approx -\dfrac{91\pi}{180} + \dfrac{\pi}{2}\]
\[= -\dfrac{\pi}{180}\]
\[\cos 91^\circ \approx -0.01745329 \quad \text{...(5)}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{2} = \frac{90\pi}{180}\), to dono terms milkar sirf \(-\frac{\pi}{180}\) chhorte hain, jo \(-1^\circ\) radians mein hai. Matlab \(90^\circ\) ke baad har ek degree par cosine takreeban utna hi kam hota hai jitna woh degree radians mein hai.

Qadam 6: Calculator se muqabla
\[\cos 91^\circ = -0.01745240 \quad \text{...(6)}\]
(5) aur (6) dekhein: calculator ki value linear approximation ke bohat qareeb hai.
Kyun: dono values paanch decimal places tak milti hain, kyun ke \(91^\circ\) centre se sirf \(1^\circ\) (takreeban 0.0175 radian) door hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[-0.01745329 - (-0.01745240)\]
\[= -0.00000089\]
Ghalti ek millionth se bhi kam hai, yani andaza behtareen hai.
blocks.answer: (a) \(L(x) = -x + \frac{\pi}{2}\), yani \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) ke qareeb \(\cos x \approx -x + \frac{\pi}{2}\). (b) \(\cos 91^\circ \approx -\frac{\pi}{180} \approx -0.01745329\); calculator \(-0.01745240\): bohat qareeb.

blocks.text:
Example 23 ki line \(\cos x \approx -x + \frac{\pi}{2}\) se \(\cos 89^\circ\) ka andaza kya hoga?
(Jawab: \(89^\circ = \frac{89\pi}{180}\), to \(\cos 89^\circ \approx \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{89\pi}{180} = \frac{\pi}{180} \approx 0.01745\). Calculator: \(0.01745\). Dekha, \(90^\circ\) se ek degree peeche jane par cosine utna hi positive hai jitna ek degree aage negative tha.)
blocks.title: Khud sochiye

blocks.text:
Example 23(b) mein kitab \(x = 91^\circ = 1.588825\) chhaapti hai. Sahi radian value \(91^\circ = \frac{91\pi}{180} = 1.588250\) hai (digits aage peeche chhap gaye hain; kitab ka aakhri jawab \(-0.01745329\) phir bhi sahi hai).
Phir kitab likhti hai "From expressions (4) and (5)"; asal mein muqabla (5) (andaza) aur (6) (calculator) ka hai, is liye "(5) aur (6)" hona chahiye. Humne upar sahi likha hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text:
\(\sqrt{4.1}\) ka andaza lagaiye. \(f(x) = \sqrt{x}\), centre \(a = 4\): \(f(4) = 2\), \(f'(x) = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\), \(f'(4) = \frac{1}{4}\).
\(L(x) = 2 + \frac{1}{4}(x - 4)\), to \(\sqrt{4.1} \approx 2 + \frac{0.1}{4} = 2.025\). Calculator: \(2.0248\). Bohat qareeb!
blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal

blocks.text: Ek baat aur samajh lein: linearization ka jawab hamesha thora sa ghalat hota hai, aur yeh ghalti kabhi zyada kabhi kam hoti hai. Agar curve upar ki taraf mudti ho (jaise \(x^{2}\)), to tangent line curve ke neeche rehti hai aur hamara andaza thora chhota aata hai. Agar curve neeche ki taraf mudti ho (jaise \(\sqrt{x}\)), to tangent line curve ke upar rehti hai aur andaza thora bara aata hai. Example 22 mein yahi hua: \(3.0333\) asal \(3.0331\) se thora bara tha. Exam mein yeh baat likh dein to examiner samajh jata hai ke aap ne concept samjha hai, sirf formula nahi lagaya.

\(\sin x\) ki \(x = 0\) par linearization: \(f(0) = \sin 0 = 0\), \(f'(x) = \cos x\), \(f'(0) = 1\). To \(L(x) = 0 + 1(x - 0) = x\), yani chhote angle ke liye \(\sin x \approx x\) (radians mein).
Misaal: \(\sin 1^\circ \approx \frac{\pi}{180} \approx 0.017453\), aur calculator \(0.017452\) deta hai. Physics mein pendulum ke sawalon mein yahi \(\sin x \approx x\) bohat use hota hai.
blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal

blocks.text:
1. \(x = a\) par \(f\) ki linearization: \(L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)\); yeh \((a, f(a))\) par tangent line hai.
2. Local linear approximation: centre \(a\) ke qareeb \(f(x) \approx L(x)\).
3. Centre aisa chuniye jo required value ke qareeb ho aur jahan \(f(a)\), \(f'(a)\) aasaan hon.
4. Trigonometric functions mein angle hamesha radians mein.
5. \(x\) jitna \(a\) se door, ghalti utni zyada (\(x^{2}\) ke liye ghalti bilkul \((x - a)^{2}\) hai).
blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein

blocks.text:
1. Formula mein number \(f'(a)\) ki jagah \(f'(x)\) likh dena: slope centre par fix hota hai, woh number hai, function nahi.
2. \(\cos x \approx -x + \frac{\pi}{2}\) mein degrees daal dena: \(x = 91\) rakhne se bilkul bekaar jawab aata hai; \(\frac{91\pi}{180}\) rakhein.
3. Andaze ke liye \(\approx\) ki jagah \(=\) likhna.
4. Required value se door ka centre chunna, jis se ghalti bohat barh jati hai.
5. Chain rule mein andar wale function ka derivative bhool jana.
blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
